description: Collect, clean and analyse business data with SQL, Excel and Python. Build dashboards and reports in Power BI or Tableau, track KPIs, apply statistics and communicate insights to stakeholders.

Explore data, engineer features and train predictive machine learning models. Use statistics, hypothesis testing and model evaluation to turn data into decisions and present findings with visualisations.
Build, train and deploy machine learning models to production. Serve models through APIs with FastAPI, package them with Docker, track experiments with MLflow and deploy them on cloud platforms.
Build applications on top of large language models. Design prompts, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines with embeddings and vector databases, integrate LLM APIs and ship generative AI features.
Process and understand text with natural language processing. Build text classification, named entity recognition and sentiment analysis models using spaCy, transformers and Hugging Face.
Build image and video understanding systems. Train convolutional neural networks for image classification, object detection with YOLO and segmentation, and process images with OpenCV.

Develop backend services and web applications in Python. Build REST APIs with Flask, Django or FastAPI, work with relational databases, write clean version-controlled code and deploy on Linux servers.
Build responsive websites and web applications. Create user interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React, consume REST APIs and collaborate through Git.
Automate infrastructure, builds and deployments. Containerise applications with Docker, orchestrate them with Kubernetes, run CI/CD pipelines and manage cloud services on AWS, Azure or GCP.
